text:
Tariq: brainstorming: multi-region write "watermark" + eviction policy to prevent tiny cross-region blobs from becoming permanent during failover flaps. want feedback.

Helena: explain watermark? sounds new.

Tariq: think of it as a soft TTL plus ownership watermark recorded on the key metadata: owner_region, owner_epoch, write_watermark_ts. writes from non-owner regions can land only if they set a transient_watermark and operator config allows eviction scanners to sweep below-watermark items after X minutes.

Gabe: so non-owner writes are allowed but explicitly marked ephemeral? how do clients know semantics?

Tariq: clients see SDK error mapping: if write accepted with ephemeral flag SDK exposes a "TransientWriteAccepted(expiry_hint)" response. apps must treat such writes as eventual and be resilient. For non-idempotent ops we still require owner lease.

Lina: metadata shape suggestion: tenant_key_meta = "owner_region:eu-west-1;owner_epoch:202;watermark_ts:1762001200;ephemeral:true|false;eviction_after_s:600". eviction scans remove keys where ephemeral==true && now > watermark_ts + eviction_after_s.

Helena: what about reconciliation? could a transparent eviction remove user-visible data that we later need?

Tariq: reconciliation rules: (1) if owner writes later with authoritative epoch, reconcile and promote non-ephemeral copy by copying to owner store then delete ephemeral; (2) if no owner write and eviction window passes, ephemeral copy is deleted and an audit event emitted.

Gabe: security/compliance: ephemeral copies must still respect PII rules. we should only allow ephemeral writes for tenants without PII or with escrowed encryption keys.

Lina: ops asks: add counters for ephemeral-writes-by-tenant, ephemeral-evictions, reconciliation-promotions, eviction-lag. Dashboards should show per-region eviction backlog.

kv-bot: note: this will require KV API change for write flags + background sweeper job.

Helena: edge-case: what if clocks drift? watermark_ts is wall-clock dependent. we should rely on monotonic service time or include signed expiry instead: watermark_expires_at = now + eviction_after_s signed by proxy with tenant-scoped key. dataplane only accepts signed expiry.

Tariq: good call. change: proxy signs expiry with X-Ephemeral-Expiry header = base64(sig(region,expiry_ts,epoch)). dataplane verifies signature using control-plane-distributed tenant key.

Gabe: pseudo-workflow for a non-owner write:
```
client -> proxy (attach X-Ephemeral-Expiry)
proxy -> dataplane: verify signature, store with ephemeral=true and watermark_expires_at
background sweeper deletes expired ephemeral keys and emits audit
owner later writes -> reconciliation promotes or deletes as needed
```

Lina: operational safety: add a global kill-switch to disable ephemeral writes and a per-tenant flag to opt-in. alert if ephemeral-evictions > threshold or reconciliation-promotions drop below baseline.

Helena: tests: clock skew simulation, owner-write-late promotion, mass failover scenario with thousands of ephemeral writes and verifying sweeper throughput.

Tariq: compliance: legal requires audit events for any ephemeral write and exportable retention for N days even if evicted. propose we snapshot ephemeral-write metadata to immutable audit store before deletion.

Gabe: performance: small objects only? large blobs could blow up replication costs. we should cap ephemeral write size and reject > threshold with 413.

Lina: add telemetry tag size_bucket and storage_cost_estimate. Also add a nightly job to summarize ephemeral volume per-tenant.

kv-bot: created tracking ticket ARCH-8802: write-watermark-eviction + ephemeral-write-signer + sweeper + telemetry.

Tariq: next steps: I'll draft short RFC with metadata fields, header proto (X-Ephemeral-Expiry + X-Ephemeral-Sig), sweep policy, and SDK error mapping. Helena/Gabe will review security and compliance bits. Lina will draft telemetry proto.

Helena: +1. I'll review crypto key rotation impact.

Gabe: +1. will prototype size checks and client SDK surface.

Lina: +1. will own dashboards and alerts.

Tariq: thanks all. will post RFC link when ready. :seedling:
